title: kbjob.py cancel ends the wrong job's process group when the executor runs jobs in parallel
goal: kj_follow.group_of finds the process group of the job asked for, not the first child of the executor that leads a group of its own: the job record's member pid names the child of that job, so cancel of one of several running jobs ends that job's group only

run: import sys; sys.path.insert(0,"_tools"); import kj_follow, inspect; assert "serve-PID" not in inspect.getsource(kj_follow.group_of)

exec("import io, os, platform, subprocess, sys, tempfile, threading, time
from argparse import Namespace
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, "_tools")
import coord, kj_exec, kj_follow, kj_store
tmp = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="plant-")
store = str(Path(tmp) / "coord.sqlite")
procs, jobs = [], []
try:
    for n in range(2):
        job = kj_store.new_id()
        rec = {"job": job, "op": "check", "subject": "", "host": platform.node(), "clone": tmp, "operator": kj_store.operator_id(), "attempt": 1, "submitted_ts": time.time() + n}
        kj_store.enqueue(store, kj_store.triple_key(tmp, "check", str(n)), rec)
        kj_store.queue(store, job, rec)
        coord.job_transition(Namespace(key="job/" + job, to="running", field=[], store=store), time.time)
        coord.claim(Namespace(key="jobrun/" + job, holder="serve-%d" % os.getpid(), ttl=60, store=store, budget=None), time.time)
        proc = subprocess.Popen(["sleep", "60"], start_new_session=True)
        kj_exec.amend(store, job, pid=proc.pid)
        threading.Thread(target=proc.wait, daemon=True).start()
        procs.append(proc)
        jobs.append(job)
    assert kj_follow.cancel(tmp, store, jobs[1], io.StringIO()) == 0
    time.sleep(0.5)
    assert procs[1].poll() is not None, "the cancelled job process still runs"
    assert procs[0].poll() is None and kj_follow.group_runs(procs[0].pid), "another job group was ended"
finally:
    [p.kill() for p in procs if p.poll() is None]
")

gates.question: When the job record holds no pid yet (cancel in the moment between the child start and the pid being written), what does cancel do?
options: cancel the job with no group to end and say so
scan the executor's children as before
gates.recommendation: cancel the job with no group to end and say so
gates.reason: the old scan is the bug, and the executor's own end of a cancelled job finds the child gone or ends it
gates.answer: cancel the job with no group to end and say so

notes: Taken into SP-lwkdljxg 2026-11-09: ST-iw7pe3mc shipped parallel serve (3 slots) relying on this fix. The repro only matches group_of's source text; the worker adds a planted behaviour check (two running jobs, cancel one, the other's process group still alive) as the item's check, read from the job record's member pid, and runs it before done.
